heading: Technical assistance
lead: Funds appropriated under this subchapter may be used by the Secretary to provide technical assistance in relation to any of the authorities under this subchapter.
sourceCredit: (July 1, 1944, ch. 373, title VII, § 799A, as added Pub. L. 105–392, title I, § 106(a)(2)(F), Nov. 13, 1998, 112 Stat. 3559.)
